digest.component_or_area: test suite — Jira Data Center transport, pagination, rate-limit retry, and port completeness
propositions: Five confirmed tests have assertions that cannot fail: PAT-repr test never receives a PAT to the transport constructor, pagination guard teeth re-implements the predicate instead of calling the shared audit helper, validate_assignee_exists test only asserts presence not return value, rate-limit sweep asserts total <= 1 allowing zero client calls, and unknown-backend test only asserts class relationship not actual raising behavior.

Each test must be rewritten to assert the contract its docstring names: the PAT must be carried by the transport and absent from repr, the pagination guard must call the parameterized shared predicate against synthetic unpaginated source and report the offender, validate_assignee_exists must return username string not bool or accountId, rate-limit retry must assert exactly one client call per member and catch BackendHTTPError with code 429, and unknown-backend must exercise select_backend against a registered name and an unregistered one.

Mutation-checking is mandatory: each rewritten test must fail RED when the production code or shared helper is mutated to break the property it claims (e.g., adding __repr__ leaking credential, making predicate always return empty, returning True or accountId, pre-flight exception before client, resolvable unknown key).

_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default helper must be parameterized with optional source argument while keeping the real guard's call unchanged, preserving exactly one predicate in the module and preventing duplication-drift.
No bug ticket filed for item 3: validate_assignee_exists contract is correctly implemented and documented on both DC and Cloud backends; the gap is purely missing assertion coverage.
Module size gates (800 LOC cap) and CI verification (py3.11/3.12/3.13 pytest, lint, type-check) must all pass green.
